rows.source: CPU execution is supported and can be slower. In one measurement on an Intel iMac (Core i5-10500, AMD Radeon Pro 5300 4 GB), Cellpose-SAM took 444.5 s on the CPU and 3.2 s on Metal for one 256×256 image, using torch 2.2.2, Python 3.12.11 and macOS 26.5.2. This is a historical example, not a speed guarantee. GPU acceleration requires a usable backend and compatible libraries. See the `recorded hardware measurement <features/new/319_use_non_nvidia_accelerators_where_they_exist.txt>`_.
